tasks.design:
HoaDonDAO: validate positive ct.soLuong and export base qty, nonnegative prices/line totals/discount/header, known employee before opening transaction. Sum stored ct totals, expected header=max(0,sum-discount); require agreement within 0.01. Allow at most 1 VND line rounding difference from qty*unitPrice for existing split allocation; no negative values. Stock UPDATE must require HSD>=CAST(GETDATE AS DATE) and positive guarded quantity; keep rowcount check/rollback. If xuatLo.QuyDoiDonVi missing, look up real base QD for that lot product with tyLeQuyDoi=1 within same transaction, ordered laDonViCoSo desc, maQD; bind its real ID, never NULL or fake. Validate QD and lot match product and base quantity equals quantity*ratio. Restore ct.thanhTien from ResultSet and preserve original header totals after loading child lists in getAllHoaDon/findById instead of recomputing DB values. Add ChiTietDoiTra.soLuongCoSoTra int property for returned base quantity INDEPENDENT of restock quantity, getters/setters. Add idempotent script sql/20261108_DoiTraCoSo.sql adding nullable soLuongCoSoTra INT CHECK>0 when nonnull. Conservatively backfill only from positive restock or unambiguous original sale unit ratio; unresolved legacy rows remain NULL, never invent quantity. In luuPhieuDoiTraTrongTransaction lock source HoaDon row UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK before checking returns, require paid source invoice. Validate every return qty>0, refund>=0; derive missing base qty only from positive restock or a single unambiguous original product conversion, otherwise reject actionable ambiguity. Under source invoice lock aggregate all prior returned base qty and current proposed base qty per product, compare to actual original ChiTietXuatLo base sold; reject over-return including two concurrent quays. Any prior unresolved NULL for that product blocks further returns pending reconciliation. If restocking, require soLo was actually sold by original invoice for same product and 0<restock<=returned base, and restock total for that lot cannot exceed sold amount. Damaged return uses restock=0 but still records positive returned base qty. Persist new base column with bound parameter, keep existing soLuongDoiTra display qty. Validate all before committing; rollback source lock, header, points, lots together. Do not implement Hotel/Spa changes in this task. Do not change public method signatures.
